content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early 2024, showing upward bias despite downward true trends.", "Sentiment shifts from bullish to bearish mid-2024 correlate with forecast divergence and price correction.", "Model forecasts lag behind true price movements by 3–5 days, indicating delayed reaction to sentiment changes.", "High sentiment positivity in early 2024 leads to inflated forecasts, which later correct sharply.", "Price mean-reversion is evident in late 2024, where forecasts overestimate highs and underestimate lows.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with recent price direction, especially in mid-2024.", "Models exhibit persistent upward bias during sentiment-driven rallies, leading to overshoots in price forecasts.", "Sentiment volatility amplifies forecast error, particularly when sentiment swings from positive to negative within 3–5 days."]}
